{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The salt pans shimmer like a thousand tiny mirrors under Inti (the sun) — bring your camera and a steady foot."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Those concentric terraces feel like a giant green amphitheatre carved for the wind."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square hums with stories under the watchful mountains."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Sun-worn stones and Inca walls hold the city's oldest heartbeat."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A plant-filled corner where the crew can refuel without a fuss."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the red-tiled roofs, and Inti (the sun) warming the old walls."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stalls of fruit, flowers and woven colour, with juice ladies calling you over."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cool stone rooms full of Inca gold, textiles and stories of the old kings."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Winding lanes of whitewashed walls, tiny galleries and balconies spilling with flowers."}]}
A gentle Cusco wander, from Inca stones to salt flats, all must-dos tucked in.
